## Display resources

*   **[Displays and Color Glossary](resources/displays-glossary.qmd):** A reference table and guide defining fundamental metrics—including luminance ($L_v$), the nit ($\text{cd/m}^2$), contrast ratio, display primaries, color gamuts (sRGB, DCI-P3, Rec. 2020), and gamma / tone reproduction curves (TRC).
*   **[Characterization of Visual Stimuli using the Standard Display Model (Artal 2024)](resources/Artal-2024/Artal-2024.qmd):** Detailed handbook chapter on computational display modeling and simulation.
